other_conditions: Must have passed 10th and 12th from any recognized school in Jharkhand or possess a local residence certificate of Jharkhand
Must know local customs, language, and culture
Must fulfill the eligibility criteria of the specific competitive examination for which coaching is sought
Applicant must not have received similar benefits from any other department (no dual benefit)
Benefit can be availed only once per student
Student must secure at least 75% attendance for the entire coaching period
Student must pass a screening test conducted by a government‑approved agency
benefits_summary: Free coaching by nationally reputed institutions in Jharkhand along with a monthly stipend of ₹2,500 per student.
